doc: A kind of wall (design/planner.md, Walls), as a config entry: its material, height, thickness, crown, towers, and how its line is laid (module, towers, straightening), so a palisade, a town wall, and a castle's curtain are data.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The kind's name (palisade, town_wall).

fields.name: material
fields.doc: What it is built of: logs (a palisade), stone, brick, earth (a bank with a timber crown), megaliths (standing stones with lintels), drystone (unmortared, irregular courses), or living wood (woven willow and hawthorn, in leaf).

fields.name: color
fields.doc: The wall.

fields.name: trim_color
fields.doc: Copings, dressings, the wall-walk's planks, log tips.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: The wall's height above the ground, metres.

fields.name: thickness
fields.doc: Its thickness at the top, metres.

fields.name: batter
fields.doc: How much wider its base is than its top, metres either side.

fields.name: footing
fields.doc: How far it reaches below its base, so steps down a slope never show a gap, metres.

fields.name: crenellated
fields.doc: Battlements along its top.

fields.name: walkway
fields.doc: A wall-walk with a parapet (a palisade's: a fighting platform on posts behind it).

fields.name: buttresses
fields.doc: Buttresses along its outer face at each module.

fields.name: tower
fields.doc: Its towers: none, square, or round.

fields.name: tower_radius
fields.doc: A tower's half width (square) or radius (round), metres.

fields.name: tower_height
fields.doc: How far a tower rises above the wall, metres.

fields.name: tower_roof
fields.doc: A tower's top: none (crenellated), a cone, or a pyramid (a dome: corbelled stone, for a stone-dome village).

fields.name: roof_color
fields.doc: Towers' roofs.

fields.name: banners
fields.doc: Banners on towers that sway.

fields.name: accent
fields.doc: Banners.

fields.name: tower_every_m
fields.doc: A tower at least this often along a straight run, metres (0: only at joins).

fields.name: tower_turn_deg
fields.doc: Bends turning at least this much get a tower (60 or 120 on the lattice; 180: never); junctions always do.
